svg.aria-label: Collider node graph: camera images flow from the Gazebo bridge into tracker, car_detector and assistant; tracker feeds target_motion, which feeds steering; steering sends cmd_vel or RC override to ArduPilot; mission drives starter and steering; safety can brake the vehicle, disable steering and cancel takeoff.
svg.title: Collider architecture, view 1: ROS 2 node graph
